address: 99 Mu 20, Airport Road, Sila, Mueang Khon Kaen, Khon Kaen, 40000, Thailand
bio: Italian chef-owner Fabio Colautti's restaurant near Khon Kaen Airport offers authentic Italian flavours with homemade pasta, wood-fired pizzas, and grilled meats. Opened in 2015, it boasts a classic Italian ambience with a cosy white interior, a large wine cellar, and an open kitchen. Highlights include the Vacca pizza and the grilled Wagyu rib-eye....
